name: Cape Canaveral SLC-41
tagline: Atlas V's main pad — flew every Atlas V mission including Mars Perseverance + Lucy + Starliner CFT
description: United Launch Alliance's primary Atlas V pad at Cape Canaveral, originally built for Titan III in the 1960s and rebuilt for Atlas V from 2002 onward. Every Atlas V flight has launched from here — Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Curiosity, Perseverance, Lucy, Juno, the Boeing Starliner Crew Flight Test, and dozens of NSSL national-security missions. Slated to host Vulcan Centaur going forward.
